paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kianh ah,
heading: TOUPA Namsau
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Jerusalem maituah inla, amun siangthou lam nga in na thu gen inla, Israel gam tung ah thu gen in;
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

paite: Israel gam kiang ah, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi: Ngai in, ka hon dou ahi, ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ding a, na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou kibang sap in ka phuk ding.
english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

paite: Huchi in na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou ka phuk ding ziak in ka namsau apai a kipan apawt ding a, simlam a kipan mallam pha in mihing tengteng aphuk ding hi.
english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA'N ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ahi chih athei ding uh, akikhum ngei nawnta kei ding hi."
english: All flesh will know that I, Yahweh, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

paite: Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, thum huthut inla khasetak in amitmuh un thum in.
english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

paite: Huan "Bangziak a thum na hia?" ahon chih uleh, "Thuthang ziak in ahi, ahong tung sin ngal a, huai hun in lungtang chiteng azul ding a, khut tengteng azaw ding a, lungsim teng abah ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in azaw ding a; ngai in, ahong tung hi, atangtun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in," achi hi.
english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Mihing tapa, thu gen inla, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi:
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.

paite: "Namsau, namsau tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahita, mi satna ding a tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahi, khophia bang in! I nuamsa lailai ding maw? ka tapa, chiang na simmoh, sing a bawl peuhmah toh,
english: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.

paite: tetsak ahi, khut a let ding in ahi namsau tat-hiam tetsak ahi, thatmi khut a tuang ding in.
english: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’

paite: Mihing tapa, kikou inla; sehal ham in, ka mite tung ahi ngal a; Israel miliante teng tung mahmah; piak ahi ua, ka mite toh, namsau nuai ah; huaiziak in kikou inla, na pheipi beng in.
english: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.

paite: Hiai namsau midang tung a chiamtehsa ahi ngal a, na ngaihsak kei hitaleh bang suak ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi."
english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in nang, mihing tapa, khut beng hial in thu gen in; thah a om dingte a ding namsau nihvei liksuk in om hen, ahi, thumvei; tampi thahna ding namsau ahi.
english: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms.

paite: Lungtang zul, apukna uh apunna ding in, namsaute kongbiang teng ah ka giaksak hi; Ah! Khophia bang in ate zolzol, sihna namsau.
english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.

paite: Nakpi'n gamtang in, taklam ah, gamtang in veilam ah leng van zel inla, na mazawn peuhmah ah leng.
english: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.

paite: Ke'n leng khut ka beng ding a, ka tangtun ngei ding, ka hehna, kei TOUPA'N hiai ka genta hi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Babulon Kumpipa Namsau
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Babulon kumpipa namsau hong tuntheihna ding in lampi nih na bawl in; huai lampi nihte gam khat a kipan in ahong pawtkhe ding uh ahi; lampi kawkmuhna bawl inla, kho pilut na khomual ah bawl in.
english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

paite: Ammon mite khua Rabbah a namsau ahong tuntheihna ding in lampi sep inla, Judah gam lai Jerusalem kulh ah leng.
english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

paite: Ai san ding in Babulon kumpipa lampi ka ah adingh a, lampi nih kigawmna tak ah; thalte asing loklok a terephim adong a, sa sin a-en hi.
english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

paite: A-aisanna ah akhut taklam ah Jerusalem ana tuang a, kulh suksiatnate galsual awng zuazuate, kongpi zawn a kulh suksiatnate, mual pawngsunte, kulh bawlte toh.
english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.

paite: Aisan vuaksuak lel bang ahi a, himahleh mat a a-omna ding ua athulimlouhna uh theihkhiakna lel ding ahi."
english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Theihgigena ding a na thulimlouhna uh na bawl ziak un na tatleknate uh ahong kilang, na thilhih tengteng uah na khelhnate uh akimu kilkel a, theihkhiak na hong hih tak ziak un khut a mat na hong hi ding uhi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.

paite: Huan nang, Israel heutu, migilou si ding a liampa, na gitlouhna gawtna tawp ni ahong tung e;
english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Heutu lukhu paihsak unla, lallukhu suhsak un, hiai angei in a-om kei ding; mivuallelte tawisang unla, miliante vuallelsak un.
english: the Lord Yahweh says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

paite: Ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding; hiai leng angei in a-om kei ding, aneimi diktak ahong pai mateng amah ka pe ding hi."
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’

paite: Huan nang mihing tapa, thu gen inla, hichi in chi in; Toupa PATHIAN in Ammon tate tungtang ah leh agensiatna thu uah hichi in achi: "Namsau, namsau phawi ahita, mithahna ding leh hihmanna ding khophia bang a tetsak ahita.
heading: Namsau Leh Ammonte
english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

paite: "Kilakna taklou nang ahon musak ua, zuau in ai ahon sansak ua, namsau bel migilou si ding a liam, agitlouhna ni uh tawp hong tung dingte ngawng ah na golh ding, ahon chih un azuau uh ahi.
english: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

paite: Apai ah thun in. Na pianna siam a na omna gam ngei ah na thu ka ngaihtuah ding.
english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.

paite: Na tung ah ka hehna ka sung dia, ka thangpaihna mei na tung ah ka toh ding, minunsetak, hihman siamtak khut ah ka hon mansak ding.
english: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.

paite: Mei a khul ding na hi ding a, gam lai ah na sisan abo ding a, theih mahmah na hita kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka genta ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: You will be for fuel to the fire. Your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will be remembered no more; for I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”’”
